title: App-plugin-served kinds need separate route wiring; manifest group may differ from served group
answers: Why does a plugin-served kind get /search but not a new generic route I just added?
How do I make a new apiserver-wide route (like list-keys) available on app-plugin-served kinds?
Why does route building from resource.AppManifests() miss plugin kinds?
body: App plugins supply their own manifest instead of appearing in resource.AppManifests(), and the group they're served under is not always the group their manifest declares. Route builders that scan compiled-in manifests + installers (like searchroutes/keysroutes) therefore miss plugin kinds unless AppPluginAPIBuilder independently calls a *ForServedGroupVersions entry point with its own manifest (group overridden to the served group) and its own served-GV map — see pkg/registry/apis/appplugin/routes.go:keysRoutes and pkg/services/apiserver/keysroutes/keysroutes.go:BuildForServedGroupVersions. Adding a new cross-cutting route without this second wiring silently excludes plugin-served kinds; a plugin spec test (pkg/registry/apis/appplugin/pluginopenapi/spec_test.go) catches the gap.
applies: Any apiserver-wide route mechanism (search, trash, list-keys, future equivalents) that must also apply to app-plugin-served kinds.
says: Plugin-served app kinds missing newly added generic API routes
Search route available but custom routes not appearing on plugins
App plugin kinds require separate manual route wiring setup
New apiserver routes silently missing from plugin-served app kinds
Route registration code not recognizing plugin kinds from different groups
search: App-plugin-served kinds do not appear in resource.AppManifests() and may be served under a different group than their manifest declares, so they are silently missed by route builders (search, trash, list-keys, and future equivalents) unless AppPluginAPIBuilder independently calls a *ForServedGroupVersions entry point with the manifest group overridden to the actual served group and the served-GV map. Adding a new apiserver-wide cross-cutting route mechanism without this second wiring causes plugin-served kinds to be excluded, caught by a plugin spec test (pkg/registry/apis/appplugin/pluginopenapi/spec_test.go). This applies to any route mechanism that must handle app-plugin-served kinds alongside standard installed kinds. Key entry points: pkg/services/apiserver/keysroutes/keysroutes.go:BuildForServedGroupVersions, pkg/registry/apis/appplugin/routes.go:keysRoutes.
